en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a book about maids
I want to scream really loud!
This is an interesting globe...

So this book is about a maid during the
Victorian era.

Are you more interested in maids in that
era rather than modern maids?

Then, I recommend studying London's customs
and cultures of that time.

You can learn which customs are passed down
to today, and which are outdated...

I assure you that you will feel accomplished
after learning such things.
Is that...a request?

If so, then I would advise you to watch
your manners.

I see potential in you.
Please do not disappoint me...

This furniture is much too high of quality to
be placed haphazardly like this.

This item would make even a connoisseur
cry with joy.

Your aesthetic sense must be impressive if
you noticed this.

Well, that is expected from
the Ultimate Detective.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
